working_definition: Davie 2018 Table S2 res-2.0 cluster 27, annotated by the authors as 'OPN: adPN and lPN' (olfactory projection neurons of the anterodorsal and lateral lineages; literature markers/mapping, Komiyama and Luo 2007; Li et al. 2017); sub-clustered into adPN and lPN groups.
searches_performed: adult antennal lobe projection neuron adPN
adult antennal lobe projection neuron lPN

best_match.fbbt_definition: Interneuron whose dendrite innervates the antennal lobe and whose axon innervates some higher brain center - generally the mushroom body calyx and/or the lateral horn.

justification: The authors' call is a group (adPN and lPN). The most specific common FBbt parent is adult antennal lobe projection neuron (FBbt:00067123): OLS hierarchical ancestors of both adPN (FBbt:00007438) and lPN (FBbt:00007439) include it. 'adult olfactory projection neuron' (FBbt:00051299) was NOT found among the ancestors of either, so it is not a valid parent.
